subject: Post-call recap: discovery capture & POC onramp next steps (Stratify.ai)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir@stratify.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@stratify.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 18:15:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap: discovery capture & POC onramp next steps (Stratify.ai)

Hi Samir / Laura —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed lightweight POC onramp so we can keep momentum:

Key pain points you called out:
- High latency and inconsistent throughput on nightly batch inference for patient triage (current 300–600 ms P50, spikes to >1.5s).
- Cost unpredictability when traffic bursts (overprovisioning vs. throttling).
- Need to keep PHI within your VPC and strict retention controls.

Success metrics we agreed to validate in the POC:
- Latency: P95 < 800ms for 1k concurrent requests (target).
- Cost: 30% token-cost reduction vs. current setup through batching/caching.
- Functionality: preserved model fidelity on our prompt-eval set (BLEU/ROUGE-like pass rate > 90% on key prompts).

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks):
1) Environment: private dedicated instance in our US region (VPC peering + service account).
2) Data: synthetic subset + hashed sample PHI (you’ll provide 1000 records via secure S3 link).
3) Owners: Naomi (Redwood AM) / Ben (Eng lead) / Karthik (Solutions) — your side: Samir (engineering sponsor), Laura (procurement/admin).
4) Deliverables: run prompt-evals, weekly perf snapshots, cost breakdown, and a short final readout with recommended config.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Samir: confirm data handoff approach (S3 link + role ARN) and preferred start week.
- Laura: indicate procurement timeline/contacts for an MSA or short-term order form.
- Redwood: share mutual action plan + SOC2 artifact and a sandbox access stub. (Attached: mutual action plan draft.)

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (PDF)]

I’ll propose a 30-min kickoff for the week of May 10 if that works for you.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Samir Khanna <samir@stratify.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@stratify.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 02:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: discovery capture & POC onramp next steps (Stratify.ai)

Thanks Naomi — good summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Data handoff: we can provide a limited sample via a pre-signed S3 link. Will create a role/ARN for the access; expecting to share by Fri 30 Apr.
- Compliance: we will need the SOC2 Type II report and an encryption/KMS note for the private instance (please attach).
- Timeline: engineering is available to start the week of May 10. Procurement would prefer a short-form PO rather than a long MSA for the initial 30-day trial; Laura is cc’d to advise.

FYI I attached our SSO/config template to speed setup.
Attachments: [attachment: stratify-ssoconfig.xlsx (Excel)]

On the metrics: P95 <800ms is reasonable as a goal; we’d like to also validate cold-start behavior for KV cache (first 10 requests after idle).

Samir
Director of Engineering | Stratify.ai
samir@stratify.ai | +1 617-555-0199

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir@stratify.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@stratify.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: discovery capture & POC onramp next steps (Stratify.ai)

Appreciate the quick reply and the SSO template — that will help. Action items we’ll take on this side:

- Redwood (Ben): provision a dedicated sandbox instance and confirm VPC peering requirements.
- Redwood (Karthik): prepare the prompt-eval set and initial batching policy to test (we’ll include cold-start tests).
- Redwood (Naomi): share SOC2 link + mutual action plan (attached) and draft PO language for a 30-day pilot.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30 min):
1) Introductions and owner confirmation (5 min)
2) VPC/permissions checklist and data transfer (10 min)
3) Performance targets & prompt-eval plan (10 min)
4) Logistics: PO/term timeline & next checkpoints (5 min)

Can we lock a slot Wed May 12 at 16:00 PT / Thu May 13 23:00 UTC? If not, suggest two alternatives.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (PDF)]
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks —
Naomi
